HomeFaq.title: Clarity before you start
HomeFaq.description: Straight answers on live data, regulatory limits, and what PRONUXFIN is — and is not.

live.q: Are quotes on the home page and market desk live?
live.a: When BRAPI_TOKEN and upstreams respond, the desk shows recent readings with freshness badges. On failure or demo mode, the UI states it explicitly — no fictional numbers posing as market data.

advice.q: Does PRONUXFIN recommend buying or selling assets?
advice.a: No. We provide reading infrastructure, educational projection, and cognitive organization. Projections and AI structure hypotheses; suitability and decisions are yours alone.

sources.q: Where does public data come from?
sources.a: Brazilian equities via BRAPI, crypto in BRL via CoinGecko, macro and calendar via Financial Modeling Prep when configured, news via RSS with visible sources. Each block shows provider and state (live, partial, or unavailable).

account.q: Do I need an account for the market desk and news?
account.a: Not for the public market layer, news, and open tools. The private desk (portfolio, alerts, dossier) requires sign-up with the same visual standard and security limits.

ai.q: How does AI fit the desk?
ai.a: As an evidence and workflow organizer — not an oracle. Answers reference available context; when data is missing, the UI says so. You validate before acting.

BolsaHub.intro: PRONUXFIN emphasises operational clarity: institutional pacing for Brazilian equities and BRL crypto, broad sector shelves on B3 plus US-listed names — explicit index proxies and feed badges — built for decisive workflows under clock pressure.
BolsaHub.riskDisclaimer: Investments carry loss risk. Quotes are indicative, may lag and differ from your broker. ETF proxies shown here are not official regulatory benchmarks. PRONUXFIN does not publish buy/sell advice on this layer — education, method and cognitive infrastructure.
BolsaHub.sectorDataFoot: Brazil sector snapshots use BRAPI aggregates (BRL). International desks use consolidated US quotes surfaced server-side via Yahoo aggregation — substitute a licensed feed for strict redistribution. Sector universes stay broad while respecting client-side sizing caps.

ProjecaoHub.lead: Model wealth paths, goals and market regimes with institutional discipline — explicit numbers, scenario bands and live context.
ProjecaoHub.leadDetail: Three return bands (downside · base · upside), sensitivity grid and goal GPS. All figures are educational hypotheses — not orders or return promises.
ProjecaoHub.warnBody: Nothing here is personalized advice, orders or guaranteed returns. Projections organize study hypotheses; real decisions require your diligence, tax and risk profile.
ProjecaoHub.boardLead: Structure upside/downside reads with asset-class drivers — committee-style framing without auto-trading.

ProjecaoHub.roadmapBody: Save compound scenarios, sync goals in financial GPS and get drift alerts when real wealth diverges — available after sign-in.
ProjecaoHub.deployFoot: Rates and inflation are editable; defaults are market references, not forecasts.
bullPoints: Global liquidity ample with inflation converging to target — supports risk assets and tighter premia.
Long curve pricing gradual cuts — multiple support for Brazil blue chips.
Net foreign inflows and earnings upgrades in export-heavy cyclicals.
Crypto risk-on: stable BTC dominance opens beta in liquid alts.
Structural commodities anchor FX and external revenues.
bearPoints: Restrictive policy longer than consensus — cost of capital stays elevated.
Corporate credit spreads widening — pressure on cycle and guidance.
Geopolitical or logistics shocks re-ignite core inflation.
Higher country risk premia — Brazilian equities and BRL under joint stress.
Fragile crypto liquidity and BTC/US equity correlation in broad sells.
